استغفلن (form X)
# اِسْتَغْفَلْنَ (istaḡfalna) /is.taɣ.fal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
# اُسْتُغْفِلْنَ (ustuḡfilna) /us.tuɣ.fil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
# اِسْتَغْفِلْنَ (istaḡfilna) /is.taɣ.fil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَغْفَلَ (istaḡfala)
